content: watchdog macOS FSEvents: editor atomic saves produce rename chains, not modify events. TextEdit save => FileMovedEvent(src=file.md, dest=file.md.sb-XXXX) + FileDeletedEvent(.sb temp) + FileCreatedEvent(file.md) + FileModifiedEvent(file.md). A handler that only listens to on_modified misses saves from rename-based editors; a handler that deletes on FileMovedEvent(src) then re-adds on Created churns the index. FSEvents coalesces events per item+path; deleted always means gone at chain end; spurious created/modified flags exist (fixed by inode pairing in watchdog PRs #750/#754, shipped ~watchdog 4.x; wrong event order in older versions, issue #538). Vim differs: writes in place (backupcopy), creates .swp and 4913 temp files; use noswapfile. FileSystemEvent instances are mutable - never use as dict keys. Sources: watchdog GitHub fsevents.py source, issues #538, PRs #750/#754, watchdog events docs.
